items.name: 검은돛 선장 퐁이
items.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE full-body isolated epic-tier game collectible thumbnail PNG, genuinely transparent background, square composition with generous 12% clear padding, no text or UI. Reference 1 is ONLY the soft painterly fantasy rendering style: delicate colored edges, rich soft gradients, dimensional gentle lighting; do NOT copy its stingray anatomy, purple palette, stars or wing fins. Reference 2 is ONLY Pongi character identity: a cute rounded golden-brown OTTER with cream muzzle and belly, rounded small ears, dark little nose, whiskers, short paws, thick tapered otter tail. Preserve this otter identity but replace thick cartoon outlines with refined soft fantasy painting. No fishing hook, fishing line or starfish accessory. Face SCREEN RIGHT in a clear side or side-three-quarter profile. The head, mouth and snout point to the right; the body and tail trail behind to the left. Show forward swimming toward the right, never backward swimming. Keep this exact right-facing orientation in the thumbnail and ALL FOUR animation frames. No left-facing, front-facing, mirrored or alternating-direction frames. This output is a SINGLE thumbnail, not an animation sheet. Clean smooth alpha silhouette, no matte fringe, no floating particles, no halo, no ground shadow, no scenery. Character: Black Sail Captain Pongi. Golden-brown and cream otter swimming horizontally right, proud warm smirk and one gently raised eyebrow. Worn ink-navy tricorn hat with a small brass otter-face and crossed-anchors emblem, one softly folded corner. Short deep-navy captain coat with burgundy lining and aged brass buttons; coat tails stream left. Small highly readable brass compass pendant on chest, rolled navigation journal secured at waist. Cozy brave captain personality, small cute compact proportions. Entire hat, paws and otter tail visible.
items.spritePrompt: Edit the attached 2x2 transparent character placement guide into a FOUR FRAME otter swimming animation sprite sheet. Keep the guide's EXACT four small character placements, head coordinates, character scale, wide transparent gutters and large outer padding. DO NOT ENLARGE the characters. Image 1 is the spatial layout to preserve. Image 2 is the high-resolution identity reference, not a request for a large full-canvas character. Change only the tail and trailing coat fabric in each of the four guide poses to form an actual swimming cycle: tail up, tail level, tail down, tail level returning. Slight synchronized hind paw propulsion. Preserve the stable captain face, tricorn, torso and forepaws, compass and journal. The entire four-character layout must remain well inside its four square cells, no cropped whiskers or tail. Use case: stylized-concept. Produce a production game animation SPRITE SHEET, square PNG, true transparent alpha. EXACTLY 2 columns by 2 rows of FOUR equally sized square cells; one complete identical character per cell. Read order top-left, top-right, bottom-left, bottom-right is frames 0,1,2,3. The attached image is the approved character IDENTITY AND STYLE reference: preserve precise otter face, fur colors, all clothing, equipment, materials, and proportions. Refined soft fantasy painted rendering with delicate colored edges, no thick black line. Face SCREEN RIGHT in a clear side or side-three-quarter profile. The head, mouth and snout point to the right; the body and tail trail behind to the left. Show forward swimming toward the right, never backward swimming. Keep this exact right-facing orientation in the thumbnail and ALL FOUR animation frames. No left-facing, front-facing, mirrored or alternating-direction frames. In each cell the otter swims horizontally toward the right in mid-water. Keep the rigid head, eyes, nose, torso center, torso size, and clothing identity EXACTLY registered to the SAME LOCAL coordinates across ALL FOUR cells. No vertical shift between upper row and lower row. No camera movement, no scale changes. Fit entire pose to 68% of each cell's width, minimum 16% transparent margin at EVERY cell edge; nothing cut off, crossing cell edges or touching neighboring cells. Four genuinely distinct phases of a smooth small-amplitude swimming cycle: 0 tail gently up, 1 tail neutral, 2 tail gently down, 3 tail returning neutral, hind paws move subtly together; short forepaws remain stable and natural, no large single-arm paddling. Secondary cloth movement follows tail phase with slight delay. All eyes open, no blink-only frames, no duplicate poses. Loop 0->1->2->3->0 smoothly. Crisp clean alpha silhouette, no halos or background residue, no scenery, particles, ground shadow, grids, frames, labels, numbers, text or watermark.

atlasPacking.method: Whole-frame integer translation with uniform transparent padding; no scaling or recoloring; every nonzero-alpha pixel preserved
